mapper.sql: select v.id, v.product_key, v.device_id, v.iot_id, v.package_type, v.custom_type, v.module, v.current_version, v.target_version, v.hardware_version, v.last_task_id, v.last_status, v.protocol, v.retry_count, v.status_detail, v.ext_info, v.create_time, v.update_time, v.last_report_time, v.last_success_time, d.device_name from iot_ota_device_version v left join iot_device d on d.product_key = v.product_key and d.device_id = v.device_id
mapper.select: where v.product_key = #{productKey} order by v.last_report_time desc, v.id desc

select current_version as version, count(*) as count from iot_ota_device_version where product_key = #{productKey} and current_version is not null and current_version != '' group by current_version order by count(*) desc, current_version desc limit 10
mapper.insert: insert into iot_ota_device_version (product_key, device_id, iot_id, package_type, custom_type, module, current_version, target_version, hardware_version, last_task_id, last_status, protocol, retry_count, status_detail, ext_info, create_time, update_time, last_report_time, last_success_time) values (#{productKey}, #{deviceId}, #{iotId}, #{packageType}, #{customType}, #{module}, #{currentVersion}, #{targetVersion}, #{hardwareVersion}, #{lastTaskId}, #{lastStatus}, #{protocol}, #{retryCount}, #{statusDetail}, #{extInfo}, now(), now(), #{lastReportTime}, #{lastSuccessTime}) on conflict (product_key, device_id, package_type, module) do update set iot_id = excluded.iot_id, custom_type = excluded.custom_type, current_version = excluded.current_version, target_version = excluded.target_version, hardware_version = excluded.hardware_version, last_task_id = excluded.last_task_id, last_status = excluded.last_status, protocol = excluded.protocol, retry_count = excluded.retry_count, status_detail = excluded.status_detail, ext_info = excluded.ext_info, update_time = now(), last_report_time = excluded.last_report_time, last_success_time = excluded.last_success_time
mapper.sql: select v.id, v.product_key, v.device_id, v.iot_id, v.package_type, v.custom_type, v.module, v.current_version, v.target_version, v.hardware_version, v.last_task_id, v.last_status, v.protocol, v.retry_count, v.status_detail, v.ext_info, v.create_time, v.update_time, v.last_report_time, v.last_success_time, d.device_name from iot_ota_device_version v left join iot_device d on d.product_key = v.product_key and d.device_id = v.device_id
